newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt drugs firm gives 96/7 forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Egypt drugs firm gives 96/7 forecasts.

text.p: Memphis Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries forecast its pretax profits for the 1996/7 financial year will rise to 27.0 million pounds from 25.75 million in the previous year, company figures showed.
The partly-private firm approved the figures at their general assembly last week and they were made available to Reuters on Monday. The financial year ends on June 30.

The firm expected its net profit in 96/7 to slip to 17.95 million from 19.79 million in 95/96. Dividends for each of the company's 2.5 million shares were also forecast lower at 4.78 pounds from 5.82 pounds in 95/6.
The state privatised 40 percent of the company in 1996 at 50.00 pounds per share. Shares closed on Monday at 79.26 pounds.
